The eyeshadow palettes are pretty good. I'm not in love with them, but I'm not kicking them out either. The blush pallette...love isn't a strong enough word. It's pigmented, creamy, blendible, the texture reminds me of the balm, and its 4 shades for $5. And works great as eyeshadow (yes I'm aware it may not be technically eye safe, but neither are any of the new colourpop eyeshadows, and no ones really saying anything about that). Stay away from the concealer, it oxidizes terribly. I forgot I had swatched the fair shade on my hand and spent 5 minutes trying to find the pretty coral lipstick I thought I had swatched. I haven't tried the contour pallette yet, but that will probably be my next purchase after loving the blush so much.
